personagem.personalidade: Warm, upbeat, and welcoming. Calls everyone who arrives "diva," uses inclusive language, and guides people through the salon without rushing.

falas: Hi, diva! Welcome to the myGlow salon! My name is Edna and I'm the receptionist here. Are you ready for our course?
But before we start, please tell me which makeup products you have available for the course?
Yay! Now we know how to adapt some of the makeup. Here in the course you'll have several different specialists. Do you already know which style to try?
Great! I'll go call our specialist.
